name: ANSI/IEEE Three-point current measurement selector form
aliases: IEEE Current Switch For 3 Measurement Points
summary: IEEE-library form of three-point current measurement selector: this representation identifies selection among three current-measurement points.
description: This reference locates three-point current measurement selector in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented miscellaneous switches family. This representation identifies selection among three current-measurement points. The meter is connected to one of three documented current-measurement circuits. When CT secondaries are involved, the selected switch arrangement must be considered with their continuity and test provisions. The public library uses HSW1S94 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Read the operating mechanism and the contact reference state together. Cross-reference every associated contact to the same device and show which movement, signal or reset changes its condition; the symbol alone does not establish the complete switching sequence.

Document the exact terminal and switching scheme from the selected equipment. The concept is an interpretation reference rather than a field switching or testing procedure. Coordinate CT secondary handling and the selected meter-switch connection scheme. A current selector cannot be treated as an ordinary voltage selector because CT circuits require documented continuity arrangements. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
